_comment: D1 dual-arm HOME pose -- the wrist-forward 'ready' pose, RE-MEASURED on hardware 2026-08-09 with the elbows slightly further out than the previous ready pose (J2 +14.4, J3 +12.4, J5 +17.7 deg from it; every joint moved, max 17.9 deg). Captured from arm_status with both arms held in TORQUE state. The raw capture was up to 1.15 deg (J6) off mirror symmetry, so each joint here is the mean of the two arms' measurements about the mirror axis -- no joint moved more than 0.57 deg from what was measured. Mirror symmetry is not cosmetic: pyguard's test_fk_home_pose asserts it to 1e-4 m and MIRROR_SIGN in test_description_consistency assumes it. 14 arm joint angles in DEGREES, executable order ArmSide::A then ArmSide::B. On this robot ArmSide::A is the physical left arm and ArmSide::B is the physical right arm. Gripper open/close is controlled separately and is not represented here. A CSV gesture pins HOME as its first and last keyframe, so changing this file means regenerating the generated gestures and re-fitting the teach recordings -- see GESTURES.md. Limits (Lite, deg): J1/J3/J5 +/-173, J2 +/-118, J4 -145..+45, J6 +/-60, J7 +/-90.
